description: This file contains the implementation of the SMTP mail class within the OpenCart system, responsible for sending emails via SMTP protocol including connection handling, command exchanges, message composition, and attachments.

classes.name: Smtp
classes.description: Provides functionality for sending emails using SMTP, including establishing connections, handling SMTP commands, composing messages with support for attachments, HTML and plain text formats, as well as handling server responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SMTP object with optional configuration parameters such as hostname, port, timeout, and other settings.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Constructs and sends an email message via SMTP, including handling of headers, body, attachments, and SMTP protocol commands.

methods.name: handleReply
methods.description: Processes SMTP server responses after issuing commands, managing retries, and validating server responses against expected status codes.
